name: Ramesh Expandable Text Toggle for Elementor
author: ztlramesh

sections.description: Ramesh Expandable Text Toggle for Elementor is a lightweight customisation widget built specifically for Elementor. It allows developers to elegantly handle long text blocks using an expandable text toggle layout, complete with both “Read More” and “Read Less” transitions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire ramesh-expandable-text-toggle-elementor folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu.
  3. Open any page in Elementor and search for “Ramesh Expandable Text Toggle”.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Fixed naming and resolved third-party trademark issues.
  • Removed inline script output to adhere to WordPress enqueue standards.
  • Updated contributor profile matching directory rules.
